content.what_it_is: EFDC+ restart (hot-start) module: MODULE RESTART_MODULE @L9 groups all restart write/read subroutines. Restart_Out (@L36-L474) gathers global arrays (call Gather_Restart_Arrays @L50), then on master only (@L53) writes RESTART.OUT (or RESTART_<date>_<hour>.OUT with ISGREGOR/TOGREGOR naming @L55-L67, CRASHST.OUT for IRSTYP == 1 @L69-L71) with version VER = 1210 @L81: header N/TIME_RESTART/VER and ISCO(0:8) @L82-L83, then per cell LG = 2..LA_Global depths (HP/H1P/H2P/HWQ/H2WQ/BELV), fluxes (UHDYE...), dry flags (ISCDRY/NATDRY/IDRY/SUB/SVB fmt 913), velocity (U/U1/V/V1 1..KC), turbulence (QQ/QQ1/QQL/QQL1/DML 0..KC), stresses (TBX/TBY/TSX/TSY and 1-forms), conditionally GOTM TKE3D/EPS3D/GL3D (@L100-L104), ice (@L105-L107), salinity, temperature, dye classes, shellfish larvae SFLSBOT/SFL, toxics TOXB/TOX per NTXM, cohesive SEDB/SED per class incl. NSEDS2 propwash extension (@L142-L150), non-cohesive SNDB/SND, bed HBED/VDRBED (@L160-L165); then open-boundary anti-diffusion counters NLOS/CLOS (S,W,E,N) with NITER rebasing (@L168-L227, GOTO 100 class loop), QSUME/QSUM (@L229-L231), channel modifier QCHANU/QCHANV (@L233-L237), groundwater AGWELV (@L239-L244), lower-chord rating-curve state (@L246-L255; formats 906/908/913 @L256-L258). Also writes SEDZLJ hot-start SEDBED_HOT.OUT VER = 1240 (@L263-L291: LAYERACTIVE/KBT/D50AVG/BULKDENS/TSED/TSED0/PERSED, CBL/CBLTOX), drifter DRIFTER.RST (@L294-L310: JSPD/KLA/LLA/XLA/YLA/ZLA), and ISDTXBUG == 1 end-of-run diagnostic dumps BEDRST.SED/SND/VDR/POR/ZHB/BDN/ELV, WATRST.SED/SND, BEDRST.BDL, BEDRST.TOX (@L323-L459, formats 101-121 @L460-L472). Restart_In (@L477-L1789) reads restart.inp on master (@L518-L520), header NRESTART/TBEGINC/Restart_In_Ver by column count (NUMCOL @L525-L531; PRESENT(OPT) short-circuit @L533-L536 used by Setup_Continuation_Files), legacy temp.rst for Ver <= 710 (@L538-L545), ISCOCHK flags for Ver >= 720 (@L548), then the mirror-image per-cell reads with version-dependent record shapes (H2P only when Ver >= 1200 @L555-L558; ISRESTIOPT /= 0 re-bases depths when file BELTMP differs from BELV @L560-L577; negative-depth STOPP / near-zero reset to HDRY*0.9 @L578-L585; dry-state record only when Ver > 1000 @L589-L591; skipped constituents consumed into TMPVAL), then broadcasts scalars/arrays via Broadcast_Scalar/Broadcast_Array (@L771-L865), maps global to local subdomain arrays via Map2Local (@L869-L1037) with GOTM minima K_MIN/EPS_MIN or QQMIN/QQLMIN/DMLMIN floors (@L913-L933), ice-cell flags, freezing-point temperature clamp (@L951-L973), NSEDFLUME-conditional bed adoption (@L1001-L1036), open-BC blocks read on master then broadcast and localized by IG2IL/JG2JL (@L1041-L1194), QSUME/QSUM (@L1195-L1210), channel modifiers/groundwater (@L1212-L1231), lower-chord rating-curve restoration setting SUB/SVB/SUBO/SVBO/UHDYE/VHDXE (@L1233-L1299), zeroing of L = 1 and LC ghost rows (@L1309-L1365), face-mask application (@L1367-L1380), UCTR/VCTR (@L1381-L1386), depth-derived HPK/HU/HV/P/P1 and inverses with sigma-zed face handling (@L1388-L1453), flux reconstruction UHDYF/VHDXF (@L1455-L1465), concentration non-negativity clamps (@L1467-L1491), velocity re-scaling when bottom elevation changed ISBELVC (@L1496-L1562), CALTSXY/CALQVS when ISDRY == 0 (@L1564-L1567), vertical velocity W/W1 from continuity (@L1569-L1581), dry/wet flag reconstruction (@L1584-L1601) and legacy rstwd.inp (@L1604-L1631), plus labeled read-error handlers 1000-1035 with formats 2000-2035/9696/9698 (@L1639-L1785). WQSDRST_IN (@L1791-L1835) reads sediment diagenesis initial conditions from wqsdrst.bin (binary) or wqsdrst.inp (ASCII, SKIPCOM); WQSDRST_OUT (@L1837-L1874) writes WQSDRST.OUT (G-class PON/POP/POC, layer nutrients, GPSI/GBST/GT header @L1868-L1872). WQ_WCRST_IN (@L1876-L1938) reads WQ water-column restart (ASCII header optionally carrying previous solar radiation WQI1-3 @L1899-L1907, or binary); WQ_WCRST_OUT (@L1940-L1978) writes it with VER = 8400 and WQCONSTIT names. WQRPEMRST_Out (@L1980-L2011) writes RPEM state WQRPS/WQRPR/WQRPE/WQRPD for LMASKRPEM cells. Setup_Continuation_Files (@L2013-L2115) copies previous output restart files into the project as input (cp/copy via SYSTEM/SYSTEMQQ per platform ifdefs) and calls Restart_In(1) for header only. Gather_Restart_Arrays (@L2117-L2460) registers every restart array with Assign_Loc_Glob_For_Write (j counted into num_arrays_to_write_out @L2436) and runs Handle_Calls_MapGatherSort, then gathers open BCs (Gather_Open_BC per side) and SEDZLJ (Gather_SEDZLJ). Gather_Open_BC (@L2462-L2552) matches local to global BC cells (IL2IG/JL2JG @L2488), flattens NLO/CLO into I1D_Global/R1D_Global (-999 sentinel), DSI_SEND to master, master merges and QCs for missing values (STOPP @L2541). Gather_SEDZLJ (@L2554-L2724) transposes (K,L)-ordered LAYERACTIVE/TSED/TSED0/BULKDENS/PERSED into (L,K) temporaries, gathers via the same mechanism plus D50AVG/CBL/CBLTOX, and reverses the global results back into (K,LG) order.

unresolved: L952-L958: freezing point TF is computed from SAL(L,KC) but the enclosing restart loop assigns cell LL (from Map2Local @L870); L is a different variable in this scope - whether SAL(L,KC) vs SAL(LL,KC) is intended cannot be resolved in this file.

L1238-L1240: the NQCTYP 3/4 lower-chord state is read from unit 1 (read(1,...)) while the restart file is open on unit UINP (@L520) and no unit-1 open precedes these reads in Restart_In; the mirror-image write in Restart_Out uses unit 99 (@L251-L253).

L702: at LG == 2 the file values are read directly into model variables NSEDS, NSEDS2 (read(UINP,*,err = 1019) NSEDS, NSEDS2), overwriting configured class counts; the non-transport branch instead reads into III, III (@L718).

L662-L671, L833, L983-L985: shellfish larvae (ISTRAN(4)) restart reads into local SFL/SFL2 with comment '! *** delme - not MPI' and the broadcast/local-populate sections are placeholders ('! PLACE HOLDER' @L833) - SFL restart is not MPI-propagated in this file.
L488, L547-L548, L620+: ISCOCHK is read only when Restart_In_Ver >= 720; for the <= 710 path ISCOCHK is used at L620/L630/L648/L662/L673/L692/L730 without any assignment in this file.
L1959, L1900-L1904: WQ_WCRST_OUT writes header version VER = 8400 but WQ_WCRST_IN only searches the header for 'RADIATION' and reads WQI1-WQI3; the version value is never parsed on input.

L2274-L2283: Gather_Restart_Arrays stores a derived total ice (ICETHICK + ICEVOL term + frazil) into ICETHICK_Global for writing, while Restart_In reads ICETHICK_Global back as plain thickness (@L613, @L936) - round-trip asymmetry not explained in this file.
L1810: WQSDRST_IN reads target cell index L from the file itself (loop counter M runs 2..LA_Global) with no bounds check on L before indexing SMPON_Global etc.
L221 NSCM0 = max(1,NSED) is computed ('Temporary variable since propwash also uses NSCM') but NSCM0 is not used anywhere else in this file.
L10-L13 header lists subroutines WSMRST, RESTMOD, RESTIN2, RESTIN10 that do not exist in this module - stale comment.
